title: GHUM & GHUML: Generative 3D Human Shape and Articulated Pose Models
summary: Wraps our generative 3D human body models - the 10,168-vertex GHUM and the 3,194-vertex GHUML(ite) - trained on over 60,000 dynamic scans with VAE shape spaces, pose-space deformation and blend skinning, into a synthetic-human data asset for the platform.
